reached_sql:
SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
INNER JOIN item ON dt.d_date_sk = item.i_rec_start_date_sk
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON item.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE item.i_manufact_id = 816 AND dt.d_moy=11
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
